title: 6/8 Time Signatures for Beginners: Counting, Feel, and Strumming (JustinGuitar)
summary: JustinGuitar’s tutorial introduces time signatures with a practical focus on 6/8. It explains that time signatures describe the feeling of beats in a bar, contrasts the common 4/4 feel with 6/8, and clarifies that 6/8 comprises six beats per bar arranged as two groups of three, with beat 1 as the strongest and beat 4 as a secondary emphasis. The video guides beginners to hear and count 6/8 by listening to sample songs, counting 1–6 (and their ‘ands’), and to practice with a metronome at a moderate tempo while emphasizing the downbeats on 1 and 4. It also covers practical strumming strategy in 6/8, including six down strums per bar, the use of subdivisions, and an upcoming lesson on a specific 6/8 pattern. A variety of song examples are suggested to reinforce the feel, and the instructor cautions about different approaches for left-handed practice while encouraging attentive listening and internalization of the rhythm.
